Acorn Thermal Unit Maintenance

ACORN_111 signals that the fallback fan has started.

Hardware Specifications

PartSpecificationTorque
Mounting BoltThe mounting hardware uses an M4 left-thread bolt.2.4 Nm
Intake FilterReplace pleated cartridge every 90 operating days.Hand-tight

Inspection Checklist

  • Verify chassis ground strap resistance stays below 0.5 ohms.
  • Record intake pressure delta before opening the service hatch.

Operational note 1 for acorn-html (cabinet-airflow): During routine shift handoffs, operators inspect the telemetry dashboard for acorn-html across rack bay 11, verify that the ambient cooling intake stays within nominal seasonal tolerances, and confirm that weekly archive rotation completed before the midnight maintenance checklist. Capacity planning teams review rolling fourteen-day utilization charts for cabinet-airflow, comparing peak burst volume against provisioned headroom and noting any scheduled firmware staging windows in the regional calendar. Incident commanders keep printed escalation trees beside the console desk and record routine drill timestamps in the shared station logbook without modifying active production parameters or altering steady-state routing weights.
